description: List all available pre-reasoned market briefings with tier requirements. Returns 33 LIVE briefings across Free (6), Basic (14), and Pro (13) tiers, plus the company briefing (equities.company), one listed company per call, for the USA on Basic and above (3,002 USA company briefings as of 2026-10-07), for Japan on Pro and above (1,546 Japanese company briefings as of 2026-10-06), for Korea on Pro and above (2,533 Korean company briefings as of 2026-10-07), for India on Pro and above (232 Indian company briefings as of 2026-10-07), for the UK on Pro and above (458 company briefings for companies filing in the UK as of 2026-10-15), for France on Pro and above (178 French company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Austria on Pro and above (46 Austrian company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Belgium on Pro and above (59 Belgian company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Denmark on Pro and above (138 Danish company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Finland on Pro and above (120 Finnish company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Iceland on Pro and above (16 Icelandic company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Italy on Pro and above (132 Italian company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Lithuania on Pro and above (20 Lithuanian company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for the Netherlands on Pro and above (92 Dutch company briefings as of 2026-10-15), for Slovenia on Pro and above (10 Slovenian company briefings as of 2026-10-15), and for Slovakia on Pro and above (8 Slovak company briefings as of 2026-10-15). Covers macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, listed companies, cross-asset and Bitcoin. Pass search with the question's words to get only the briefings that match, best first; when it names a company, the answer also lists the matching covered companies, each with the entity to pass to get_context. No authentication required.

search.description: The question or its key words (for example "is the yield curve inverted" or "Toyota earnings"). Returns the matching briefings, best first, at most five, and any covered companies it names (at most five).

tier.description: Filter briefings by subscription tier (free, basic, or pro). Returns all tiers if omitted.
